📖 How to use

  1. Enter total fixed costs, price per unit and variable cost per unit.
  2. Read the break-even units and revenue instantly.
  3. Sell more than the break-even units to profit.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is break-even calculated?

Break-even units = fixed costs ÷ (price − variable cost). Break-even revenue = break-even units × price.

What if price is below variable cost?

You must raise the price, cut variable costs, or reduce fixed costs — otherwise each unit sold loses money.

How do I add a target profit?

Enter a target profit as extra fixed cost… simplest: required units = (fixed costs + target profit) ÷ contribution margin.
